name: epub-viewer
author: hellokunzai
description: A clean, focused e-book reader for Obsidian. Open EPUB, MOBI, AZW3, FB2, CBZ and TXT inside your vault; enjoy paginated or continuous scrolling, adjustable font size, reading themes, table of contents, full-text search, a progress bookshelf and reading-time tracking.

scripts.verify: npm test && npm run typecheck && node scripts/verify-release.mjs
